# Grok Bot skills

> Free Grok Bot and AI agent SKILL.md templates with standing safety rules, plus paid skill packs for a multi-bot fleet, reminders, a credit coach, and a project sprint.

A skill is an instruction file a Grok Bot or similar AI assistant follows. The free skills in https://github.com/skillsforbots/grok-bot-skills are MIT-licensed. Paid packs are sold separately on Gumroad under their own terms.

## Free skills

- [Bot Safety Rules Starter](https://github.com/skillsforbots/grok-bot-skills/blob/main/skills/bot-safety-rules-starter/SKILL.md): Standing rules that no bot sends email or messages without owner approval, no bot spends money, and a one-time approval is not a standing waiver, plus a blank structured handoff note.
- Also on Agensi: [Bot Safety Rules Starter](https://www.agensi.io/skills/bot-safety-rules-starter)
- [Reminder Basics](https://github.com/skillsforbots/grok-bot-skills/blob/main/skills/reminder-basics/SKILL.md): One reminder that repeats daily until the owner clearly says it is done. Free, limited version of Nag-Until-Cleared Reminders (one item, one daily time).
- Also on Agensi: [Reminder Basics](https://www.agensi.io/skills/reminder-basics)
- [Usage Reset Sprint](https://github.com/skillsforbots/grok-bot-skills/blob/main/skills/usage-reset-sprint/SKILL.md): Use leftover usage on a project right before a usage or token limit resets: check remaining usage and the reset time, finish the highest-value chunk that fits, and leave a handoff so work can resume after the reset. Does not buy credits or spend money to get more usage. Free, limited version of Project Sprint (one window, one handoff).
- Also on Agensi: [Usage Reset Sprint](https://www.agensi.io/skills/usage-reset-sprint)

## Premium packs

- [Bot Fleet Coordinator](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/ergple): $12. A primary bot that routes each task to the right specialist, writes a handoff note, and follows no-send / no-spend rules.
- Also on Agensi: [Bot Fleet Coordinator](https://www.agensi.io/skills/bot-fleet-coordinator)
- [Nag-Until-Cleared Reminders](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/hdqoqb): $9. Reminders that keep coming back until you clearly say an item is done.
- Also on Agensi: [Nag-Until-Cleared Reminders](https://www.agensi.io/skills/nag-until-cleared-reminders)
- [Credit Repair Coach](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/ifujn): $12. Educational daily or on-demand credit briefs with today's top 3 actions, labeled estimates, and letter drafts you send yourself. Not financial or legal advice; no results promised.
- Also on Agensi: [Credit Repair Coach](https://www.agensi.io/skills/credit-repair-coach)
- [Project Sprint](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/project-sprint): $19. Plan a project across several usage windows, finish a high-value chunk before each reset, and pick up from a handoff after, without buying more credits.
- Also on Agensi: [Project Sprint](https://www.agensi.io/skills/project-sprint)
- [Bot Owner Starter Bundle](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/vxecie): $19. The Bot Fleet Coordinator, Nag-Until-Cleared Reminders, and Credit Repair Coach in one download (saves $14 vs $33 separately).
- Also on Agensi: [Bot Owner Starter Bundle](https://www.agensi.io/bundles/bot-owner-starter-bundle)

## Guides

- [How to stop your AI bot from spending money](https://skillsforbots.github.io/how-to-stop-ai-bot-spending-money/): Platform limits, keeping payment details away from bots, a standing no-spend rule, and hidden costs like trials that bill later.
- [How to make AI bot reminders that don't stop until you're done](https://skillsforbots.github.io/ai-bot-reminders-that-dont-stop/): Defining what counts as done, a two-line reminder message, and a daily routine setup.
- [How to coordinate multiple AI bots](https://skillsforbots.github.io/coordinate-multiple-ai-bots/): One lane per bot, a single coordinator, a written handoff note, shared safety rules, and a weekly read-only review.
- [How to make your AI bot ask before it acts](https://skillsforbots.github.io/ai-bot-ask-before-acting/): A standing approval rule for sending, posting, or spending, with one-time yes staying one-time, plus a test and platform settings.
- [How to get a daily credit action plan from an AI bot](https://skillsforbots.github.io/ai-bot-daily-credit-action-plan/): A short daily or on-demand brief with today's top 3 actions, figures labeled as estimates, and letter drafts you send yourself. Educational only; not financial or legal advice; no results promised.
- [How to add a skill to your AI bot](https://skillsforbots.github.io/how-to-add-a-skill-to-your-ai-bot/): What a SKILL.md file is, how to fill placeholders and add it as standing instructions, and how to test that it loaded.
- [How to make your AI bot use its remaining usage before the limit resets](https://skillsforbots.github.io/ai-bot-use-remaining-usage-before-reset/): Check remaining usage and the reset time, finish the highest-value chunk that fits, leave a handoff, and resume after reset, without buying more credits.
